scope: Current indexed official Carrefour Nata category with the Carrefour brand facet applied. This is a bounded category checkpoint, not a claim that the full Carrefour catalog is inventoried.
notes: The official category page retrieved during this audit reported 3 Carrefour-brand products and exposed all three product links.

Other indexed Carrefour category/search snapshots from recent crawls report larger Carrefour-brand counts (up to 8), so this checkpoint deliberately claims completeness only for the current indexed snapshot and does not retract previously observed first-party products.

All three linked product pages exposed price, unit price, full core nutrition, ingredients, legal denomination, net content and additional product metadata; allergens were persisted only when Carrefour exposed an explicit allergen field.
No external product facts were used. Indexed official-page retrieval can lag, so prices are evidence of Carrefour-published values, not assertions of live availability.
